Name: Clay for Sale
Author: wulfricViking
Description:
Clay can be annoyingly hard to come by at the beginning of the game. This mod utilizes Content Patcher to add clay as a purchasable item in Robin's shop. Price is 200g/clay based on Robin's markup of stone and wood. Each of those is at least 10x the sell price. This is changeable in the content.json file.



[b][size=4]Installation
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Install [url=http://]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=http://]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download and unzip this mod to [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] .
[/list][size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size][size=2]In the [font=Courier New]content.json[/font] file:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Price:  200[/size]
[/list]
